Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 2  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the best answer to the problem was Option B ("High mountains gradually wear down until most of the Earth is at sea level") based on their analysis. While the Planner acknowledged both erosion and uplift processes, they failed to account for the continuous formation of new mountains through tectonic activity, which balances the erosion of existing mountains over geological timescales. This oversight led to the erroneous selection of Option B instead of the correct answer, Option C ("High mountains gradually wear down as new mountains are continuously being formed, over and over again").
